hero.bio: I design and build scalable web solutions with Angular, Ruby on Rails, and Node.js. Pioneer in AI-augmented hybrid development.

about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Senior Full Stack Developer
about.description1: Senior Full Stack Developer with over 12 years of experience designing and implementing scalable and efficient web solutions. Specialized in microfrontend architectures using Angular and backend development with Ruby on Rails and Node.js.
about.description2: I stand out as a pioneer in AI-augmented hybrid workflows (Vibe Coding, Spec-Driven Development), employing advanced autonomous agents like Copilot, Kiro, and Antigravity to accelerate value delivery and elevate quality standards.

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.description: Development of hybrid applications (Ionic, Capacitor) for the financial sector using Angular (up to v21), Redux, and TypeScript. Led migration to Microfrontends (Single-SPA, Module Federation, Web Components), local automation with Docker, and QA with SonarQube.

jobs.title: Semi-Senior Software Developer
jobs.description: Built critical transactional modules using Angular (11-13). Contributed to highly scalable architectures and integrated security tools like SonarQube, Fortify, and Blackduck.

jobs.title: Web Developer
jobs.description: Comprehensive development of Backend and Frontend modules (Ruby on Rails, JavaScript) for the Incwo.com CRM. Integrated AWS cloud services and Google APIs, along with E-commerce optimizations.
